text.text: What is the difference between a traditional hair dryer and a high-speed hair dryer?
text.fontFamily: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, Tahoma, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Heiti SC", "WenQuanYi Micro Hei", sans-serif

text.text: The primary differences between traditional hair dryers and high-speed hair dryers lie in their motors, airflow speed, temperature, and additional features. High-speed hair dryers typically utilize brushless motors, offering faster rotational speeds and higher airflow velocities; moreover, they often incorporate hair-care functions—such as negative ion technology—to protect the hair. In contrast, traditional hair dryers predominantly employ carbon-brush motors, which generate lower airflow speed
